description: 人物正面端坐，肩线稳定，身体朝向镜头；双臂自然下垂，不在胸前展开手势。
constraints: 保持人物脸、发型、肤色、黑 T 和体型不变
双臂自然下垂，双手不进入画面
完整保留头发，不缩成小头像，不展示全身

framing_rules.3:4: Match the approved framing reference: lower-left anchor; top of hair at about 42–45% of canvas height; body continues through the bottom edge. Show the complete head, neck, shoulders, chest and upper abdomen, cropping near the waist. Presenter occupies about 42–46% of canvas width and 55–60% of canvas height. Both hands remain outside the frame. Do not reduce this to a head-and-shoulders portrait and do not show the full body.
